settings.eyebrow: A premium pumpkin display, designed for your entry
settings.heading: Curate your arrival.
settings.text: A bespoke pumpkin and gourd installation designed for your stoop, porch, or storefront. Choose your palette and scale. We handle the delivery and styling.
settings.caption: Plate 01 / The Porch

settings.title: Compose your entry in three steps.
settings.text: Build your complete seasonal composition here. Review every choice and the live estimate before approving your design.

settings.title: 01 / Find your palette
settings.text: Choose the color direction that suits your entry. Matching studies appear only when photography is available.

settings.title: 02 / Set the scale
settings.text: Compare The Stoop, The Porch, and The Estate alongside the live design review.

settings.title: 03 / Complete and review
settings.text: Choose delivery or installation, timing, artwork and removal. Approve your composition, then review every detail before checkout.

settings.title: An entrance to remember.
settings.text: Compose a seasonal welcome with the care you would give any other room. Begin with a considered color story, then find a scale suited to your architecture.
settings.summary_disclosure: Your choices appear here as you make them. Palette photographs show color direction, not a rendering of the finished display.
settings.continue_disclosure: Approval adds your composition to cart for review and does not place an order or reserve a week.

settings.title: Architectural styling for the season.
settings.text: Palette Install approaches the seasonal entry as an extension of the spaces within. Select a considered display for a residential porch, stoop, or storefront.

settings.question: How long do the pumpkins last?
settings.answer: Longevity varies with weather and exposure. Contact us for guidance on caring for your display.

settings.question: Do I need to be home for the installation?
settings.answer: We will confirm access and installation details with you before the visit.
